# Read from default configuration.
zb configuration get debug
stdout '\Afalse\n\z'

# Read from user-specified file.
zb configuration get --config=foo.json debug
stdout '\Atrue\n\z'

# Read path from user-specified file.
zb configuration get --config=foo.json server.download.url
stdout '\A"http://www.example.com"\n\z'

# Fail for unset setting.
! zb configuration get bork

-- foo.json --
{
  "debug": true,
  "server": {
    "download": "http://www.example.com"
  }
}
